canvas.coordinates: Every t is a FINAL-spine second, before the card pauses; the comp and mix_music.py route them through sh(). Title cards at 62.94 (CH2), 232.66 (CH3, the mid-bed exception, Mike's ruling pending), 445.96 (CH4), 704.04 (CH5), 879.56 (CH7); the breath lives inside each card pause (graph default 1.5 s: the outgoing bed fades 0.4 s from the card start, 0.6 s of air, the incoming bed fades in over 0.5 s and is full on the chapter's first word). source_in is the file position ON the chapter's first word (the mixer pre-rolls the fade-in before it). BED E LOOP COUNT MARGIN: the placement is 241.94 s against 182.84 s of file, so three 8-bar passes (60.63 s) cover it with 1.53 s to spare (the head trim). Not a correctness failure, but check mix_music.py --dry-run (it prints each loop's extra passes and trims) after the comp is built; if the pass count reads 4, either keep the tail off or accept the hot entry.
